column1: # build-demo.edit.tsv — the cut used for docs/media/build-demo.gif.
# The frames are real screenshots of one real run, taken by scripts/capture-demo.sh on
# 2026-08-14 between 05:58 and 06:43 local time (619 kept of 1103 taken; the rest were
# pixel-identical to the frame before them). The negatives are NOT committed — 418 MB of
# full-resolution PNGs — so this file plus the capture directory's manifest.tsv is the
# record of what was used and what was left on the floor.
# What is cut and why: the run took 45 minutes, most of it four agents working in silence.
# Everything a person decides — the question, the answer, the gate, each hire — is held
# for seconds. The 14 minutes of building is a 3-second timelapse. Nothing is reordered;
# Two honest gaps, stated rather than patched:
#   - There is no frame of the question with an empty answer box. By the time the cockpit
#     was attached at 06:06:29 the answer was already typed, so the run opens on both.
#   - Frames where the operator switched to another window (a second terminal, Mission
#     Control) are skipped. They are still in the capture directory; they are just not the

column3: # the cockpit, one pane: "What do you want to build today?" and the answer
# still waiting on a human — nothing has been built yet
# Enter. "Captured. Refining into build/MISSION.md"
# the lead reads IDEA.md, loads prompt-engineer, reads team/ROLES.md
# a mission appears: Ozymandias, 2s cadence, one self-contained file
# THE GATE — "Proceed as written?" Nothing is hired until a person answers
# "Hiring the team now — small scope: implementer, designer, accessibility, verifier"
# implementer hired — two panes
# designer hired — three panes
# accessibility hired — four panes
# verifier hired — five panes, and that is the whole team
# the contract is shared; the team starts talking to each other
# fourteen minutes of building, in three seconds
# the verifier runs its own headless browser against the file on disk
# criteria coming back PASS, one at a time
# "all 7 MISSION.md success criteria PASS" — verified by an agent that did not build it
# mission closed, every role signed off, EVIDENCE.md written
# the page itself, opened from disk: line one
# line four
# line eight
# line twelve
# all fourteen lines and the signature — the timer stops, the page settles
